## P1: Planning, Permits and Budgeting
> Establish budget controls, finalize design, and obtain required permits.
- [ ] T1: Set up budget tracking system (2d) @Priya !high
- [ ] T2: Finalize kitchen design and material selection (1w) @Jordan !high depends: T1
  notes: Select specific cabinets, countertops, and electrical layout.
  - [ ] Choose cabinet style and layout
  - [ ] Select countertop material
  - [ ] Plan electrical outlet and fixture locations
- [ ] T3: Submit building and electrical permit applications (1d) @Priya !high depends: T2
- [ ] T4: Secure contractor quotes and schedule trades (1w) @Jordan depends: T2
- [ ] M1: Permits approved and contractors scheduled depends: T3, T4

## P2: Demolition and Rough-In
> Clear the old kitchen and update infrastructure before installation.
- [ ] T5: Clear kitchen and execute demolition (3d) @Jordan depends: M1
  - [ ] Remove old cabinets and countertops
  - [ ] Disconnect and store appliances
- [ ] T6: Rough-in electrical wiring and updates (4d) @Jordan depends: T5
  notes: Must align with new layout before walls are closed up.
- [ ] T7: Rough-in electrical inspection (1d) @Priya depends: T6
- [ ] M2: Rough-in inspection passed depends: T7

## P3: Installation and Finishes
> Install major components and complete finish work.
- [ ] T8: Install new cabinets (3d) @Jordan depends: M2
- [ ] T9: Template, fabricate, and install countertops (1w) @Jordan depends: T8
- [ ] T10: Connect electrical fixtures, outlets, and appliances (2d) @Jordan depends: T9

## P4: Final Inspection and Wrap-Up
> Complete official checks, final touches, and budget review.
- [ ] T11: Schedule and pass final permit inspection (1d) @Priya !high depends: T10
- [ ] T12: Perform punch list touch-ups and cleanup (2d) @Jordan depends: T11
- [ ] T13: Reconcile final project expenses against $30k budget (2d) @Priya depends: T12
- [ ] M3: Project complete and inspected depends: T11, T13
